import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    pos = 0
    N = int(data[pos]); pos += 1

    M = 500000
    size = M  # Fenwick covers indices 1..M; we never query beyond M

    bit = [0] * (size + 1)
    # Initialize D[i]=1 for i=1..M; for Fenwick with all D=1, bit[i] = i & -i
    for i in range(1, M + 1):
        bit[i] = i & (-i)

    LOG = 1
    while LOG * 2 <= size:
        LOG *= 2

    for _ in range(N):
        L = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
        R = int(data[pos]); pos += 1

        # Xlo: smallest i with prefix sum >= L
        target = L
        p = 0
        s = 0
        r = LOG
        while r > 0:
            np_ = p + r
            if np_ <= size and s + bit[np_] < target:
                p = np_
                s += bit[np_]
            r >>= 1
        Xlo = p + 1

        # Xhi: largest i with prefix sum <= R, i.e., (smallest i with prefix sum >= R+1) - 1
        target = R + 1
        p = 0
        s = 0
        r = LOG
        while r > 0:
            np_ = p + r
            if np_ <= size and s + bit[np_] < target:
                p = np_
                s += bit[np_]
            r >>= 1
        Xhi = p  # already in [0, size] = [0, M]

        if Xlo <= Xhi:
            i = Xlo
            while i <= size:
                bit[i] += 1
                i += i & -i
            i = Xhi + 1
            while i <= size:  # no-op when Xhi == M, which is correct
                bit[i] -= 1
                i += i & -i

    out = []
    Q = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
    for _ in range(Q):
        X = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
        s = 0
        i = X
        while i > 0:
            s += bit[i]
            i -= i & -i
        out.append(str(s))

    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(out))
